name: Restaurant cards
summary: Restaurants or stores in a list: a cover photo, name, cuisine and price level, rating with its count, delivery time and fee, an offer line and a favourite toggle.
use: in a food delivery or local shops app, for browsing places nearby
a11y: Each card is one link (its name) that covers the card, with the focus ring on the cover; save is a separate toggle button named for its place, and the rating is read as words.

use_when: a 'near you' or 'popular' row of places on a home screen, where each card opens that place's menu
avoid_when: one dish with its options: use menu-item
places to stay with dates and nightly prices: use stay-card
products from one shop: use product-card or wishlist-grid

parts.name: subtitle
parts.what: where the list is for, such as the delivery address

parts.name: places
parts.what: one place card; the whole card opens the place

parts.name: save
parts.what: a heart toggle to save the place

parts.name: name
parts.what: the place's name, the link that covers the card

parts.name: rating
parts.what: the star rating and how many ratings

parts.name: meta
parts.what: delivery time and fee, each with an icon

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if saving fails, flip the heart back and show toast-stack; if the list fails, show alert-banners under the heading

disabled.how: for a place that is closed, dim the cover, replace the delivery time with 'Opens at 5 pm' and keep the card a link

overflow.how: cards sit in one, two or three columns by the box width; a long list adds rows

long_text.how: the place name is cut off with an ellipsis so the rating stays on its line; the rating count hides in a very narrow card

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab moves, for each card, to the save heart and then the place's name link
Enter on the name opens the place; the focus ring shows on the cover
Enter or Space on the heart saves or unsaves the place
